Indiana University Datathon and Machine Learning Competition

Placed in the Top 3 Teams at Indiana University's Datathon, where our team researched offensive language detection on social media. We built and annotated a large dataset, then fine-tuned a HuggingFace transformer model in PyTorch to enhance hate-speech detection accuracy while studying the ethical implications of NLP in moderation systems.

  • Placed in Top 3 overall among collegiate teams
  • Achieved +14% accuracy improvement over baseline model
  • Created and validated 500+ labeled data points for hate-speech detection
  • Presented findings on AI ethics, fairness, and policy implications to industry leaders

Gained a deeper understanding of how data quality and model tuning shape both accuracy and fairness in real-world NLP systems.
